title: Mini Ultra Suede® Sculpting Lip Pencil Trio Gift Set
descriptionHtml:
✓ Vegan✓ Full Coverage✓ Long-wearing✓ Matte Finish✓ Cruelty-Free
What it is: A mini lip liner trio in bestselling shades of Mario’s Ultra Suede® Sculpting Lip Pencil to define, sculpt, and shape the lips.

What Else You Need to Know: This set features top shades: Toasty, Smokey Pink, and Travis. The matte, full-coverage formula is infused with emollients for comfortable wear. No feathering or bleeding. Lip-lock technology extends wear of lipstick. Contour-shape technology whips lips into shape and creates the perfect Cupid’s bow.

This Set Contains:
- 3 x 0.03 oz/ 0.9 mL Ultra Suede® Sculpting Lip Pencils in Travis, Smoky Pink, Toasty
How to Use+
Suggested Usage:
-Slightly overline the upper lip line, focusing on the Cupid’s bow.
-Slightly overline the center of the bottom lip line.
-Extend upwards, moving the liner inside the lip line.
-Softly diffuse and blend the lip pencil with built-in brush and finish with your favorite lip color.
Ingredients+
Ultra Suede® Sculpting Lip Pencil in Travis:
Triethylhexanoin, Polyethylene, Hydrogenated Polyisobutene, Dipentaerythrityl Tetrahydroxystearate/Tetraisostearate, Microcrystalline Wax (Cera Microcristallina), Mica, Dicalcium Phosphate, Synthetic Wax, Pentaerythrityl Tetra-Di-T-Butyl Hydroxyhydrocinnamate, Bht [May Contain/Peut Contenir (+/-): Titanium Dioxide (Ci 77891), Iron Oxides (Ci 77491, Ci 77492, Ci 77499), Red 6 (Ci 15850), Red 7 Lake (Ci 15850), Blue 1 Lake (Ci 42090)].

Ultra Suede® Sculpting Lip Pencil in Toasty:
Triethylhexanoin, Polyethylene, Hydrogenated Polyisobutene, Dipentaerythrityl Tetrahydroxystearate/Tetraisostearate, Microcrystalline Wax (Cera Microcristallina), Dicalcium Phosphate, Mica, Synthetic Wax, Pentaerythrityl Tetra-Di-T-Butyl Hydroxyhydrocinnamate, Bht [May Contain/Peut Contenir (+/-): Titanium Dioxide (Ci 77891), Iron Oxides (Ci 77491, Ci 77492, Ci 77499), Red 7 Lake (Ci 15850)].

Ultra Suede® Sculpting Lip Pencil in Smokey Pink:
Triethylhexanoin, Polyethylene, Hydrogenated Polyisobutene, Dipentaerythrityl Tetrahydroxystearate/Tetraisostearate, Microcrystalline Wax (Cera Microcristallina), Mica, Dicalcium Phosphate, Synthetic Wax, Pentaerythrityl Tetra-Di-T-Butyl Hydroxyhydrocinnamate, Bht [May Contain/Peut Contenir (+/-): Titanium Dioxide (Ci 77891), Iron Oxides (Ci 77491, Ci 77492, Ci 77499), Red 6 (Ci 15850), Red 7 Lake (Ci 15850), Blue 1 Lake (Ci 42090)].
